# epx

> Read and manage your Emporix tenant from the command line.

## Get started

- [Overview](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/index.md): Read and manage your Emporix tenant from the command line.
- [Install epx](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/install.md): Install epx with npm, from a release archive, or with Go, and set up shell completion.
- [Authenticate](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/configure.md): Give epx an Emporix API key through environment variables or a profile, with only the scopes your commands need.
- [Quickstart](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/quickstart.md): Go from an Emporix API key to your first epx reads in five minutes.

## Guides

- [Format output](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/guides/output.md): Print what Emporix answers as a table, CSV, JSON, YAML, or JSON Lines, and choose columns and languages.
- [List, filter, and sort](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/guides/lists.md): Read every page of a list, and narrow it with a limit, a query, and a sort order.
- [Call any API endpoint](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/guides/api.md): Send a request to any Emporix API path with epx api, using only the OAuth scopes you name.
- [Change data](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/guides/writes.md): Create, update, and delete data in your tenant with dry runs, confirmation, and explicit scopes.
- [Bulk writes, chains, and jobs](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/guides/bulk.md): Write many items in one request, import files of any size, run cart command chains, and wait for jobs.
- [Exit codes and scripting](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/guides/exit-codes.md): Use epx in scripts and CI: what each exit code means, how errors look, and how epx retries.

## Concepts

- [Security model](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/security.md): How epx handles credentials, OAuth scopes, network requests, and the data it prints.

## Commands

- [CLI reference](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/index.md): Every epx command and flag, with the OAuth scopes each one requests.
- [epx ai](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/ai.md): Read and change AI agents and their setup, chat with them, generate texts.
- [epx api](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/api.md): Send requests to any Emporix API path.
- [epx auth](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/auth.md): Check Emporix credentials.
- [epx availability](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/availability.md): Read and change availability.
- [epx brands](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/brands.md): Read, create, change and delete brands.
- [epx carts](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/carts.md): Read and change carts and their items and discounts.
- [epx catalogs](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/catalogs.md): Read and change catalogs.
- [epx categories](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/categories.md): Read and change categories and the products assigned to them.
- [epx category-trees](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/category-trees.md): Read and rebuild category trees.
- [epx changelog](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/changelog.md): Read the change history (audit log).
- [epx completion](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/completion.md): Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell.
- [epx configurations](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/configurations.md): Read and change tenant configurations.
- [epx contact-assignments](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/contact-assignments.md): Read and change which customers are contacts of which legal entities.
- [epx countries](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/countries.md): Read countries, and activate or deactivate them.
- [epx coupons](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/coupons.md): Read, create, change and redeem coupons.
- [epx currencies](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/currencies.md): Read, create, change and delete currencies.
- [epx custom-entities](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/custom-entities.md): Read and change custom entity types and their instances.
- [epx customer-locations](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/customer-locations.md): Read and change the locations of B2B customers.
- [epx customers](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/customers.md): Read and change customers and their addresses.
- [epx delivery-times](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/delivery-times.md): Read and change delivery times and their time slots; read the delivery windows of a cart.
- [epx exchange-rates](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/exchange-rates.md): Read, create, change and delete currency exchange rates.
- [epx fees](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/fees.md): Read and change fees and which items have them.
- [epx iam](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/iam.md): Read and change IAM users, groups and access rights.
- [epx imports](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/imports.md): Read import configurations, runs and imported records; start and schedule runs.
- [epx indexing](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/indexing.md): Read and configure search index providers; reindex.
- [epx invoice-jobs](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/invoice-jobs.md): Create and read invoice jobs.
- [epx labels](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/labels.md): Read, create, change and delete labels.
- [epx legal-entities](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/legal-entities.md): Read and change legal entities (B2B companies); read their parents.
- [epx media](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/media.md): Read, upload, link and change media assets.
- [epx orders](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/orders.md): Read, create and change orders and their status.
- [epx payment-modes](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/payment-modes.md): Read, create, update and delete payment modes.
- [epx payment-transactions](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/payment-transactions.md): Read payment transactions; authorize, capture, refund and cancel payments.
- [epx price-lists](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/price-lists.md): Read and change price lists and their prices.
- [epx price-models](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/price-models.md): Read and change price models.
- [epx prices](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/prices.md): Read and change prices.
- [epx product-templates](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/product-templates.md): Read, create, update and delete product templates.
- [epx products](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/products.md): Read, create, update and delete products.
- [epx profile](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/profile.md): Manage profiles: named settings and credentials of a tenant.
- [epx quotes](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/quotes.md): Read, create and change quotes, their PDF, history and reasons.
- [epx regions](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/regions.md): Read regions.
- [epx returns](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/returns.md): Read, create, change and delete returns.
- [epx reward-points](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/reward-points.md): Read and change reward points and the ways to redeem them.
- [epx schemas](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/schemas.md): Read, create, change and delete custom schemas and schema references.
- [epx search](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/search.md): Search documents; read and change search indexes and saved searches.
- [epx segments](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/segments.md): Read and change customer segments and what is assigned to them.
- [epx sequential-ids](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/sequential-ids.md): Read, create, activate and delete sequential ID schemas; issue IDs.
- [epx session-contexts](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/session-contexts.md): Read and change session contexts.
- [epx shipping](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/shipping.md): Read and change shipping zones, methods and groups, and calculate shipping fees.
- [epx shopping-lists](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/shopping-lists.md): Read, create, replace and delete customers' shopping lists.
- [epx sites](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/sites.md): Read, create and change sites and their mixins.
- [epx taxes](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/taxes.md): Read and change tax configurations, and calculate net and gross prices.
- [epx units](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/units.md): Read and change units of measurement; read unit types and convert between units.
- [epx vendor-locations](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/vendor-locations.md): Read and change the locations of vendors.
- [epx vendors](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/vendors.md): Read and change vendors.
- [epx version](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/version.md): Print the epx version.
- [epx webhooks](https://commerce-cloud-integrations.github.io/emporix-cli/commands/webhooks.md): Read and change webhook configurations and subscriptions; read statistics.
